hero.title: A precise natal chart in your browser
hero.subtitle: Our own ephemeris engine built on NASA JPL data. Free, and no account needed.

liveChart.title: This is what your chart looks like
liveChart.subtitle: A wheel that reads clearly to a beginner and to a professional astrologer.
liveChart.ascBody: The sign rising in the east at the moment of birth. The horizontal line on the left.
liveChart.mcBody: The highest point of the chart — vocation and career. The vertical axis at the top.
liveChart.housesBody: Twelve areas of life. Their numbers sit on the inner ring.
liveChart.aspectsBody: The lines in the centre are angles between planets. Blue and green are harmonious, red is tense.
liveChart.caption: Example: 1 January 1990, 12:00, Kyiv. Made-up data.

techniques.title: Three techniques in one place
techniques.natalBody: Planets, houses and aspects for any date from {from} to {to}.
techniques.transitsBody: How today's sky acts on your chart, and a forecast for the year from your birthday.
techniques.synastryBody: Two charts compared: the aspects between two people's planets.

pro.title: For professional practice
pro.subtitle: Techniques you usually only find in desktop software.
pro.termsBody: The term ruler for every planet.
pro.arabicBody: The Part of Fortune and other parts alongside the chart.
pro.minorBody: Quincunx, quintile, sesquiquadrate and more — on the Pro plan.
pro.timezonesBody: A city's clock is taken as it was in the year of birth, not as it is today.
pro.personsBody: Clients' and family members' details to hand, no retyping.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Start typing a city — coordinates and time zone fill themselves in.
how.step2Body: The calculation takes a few tens of milliseconds.
how.step3Body: Save the chart, then add transits, a solar return or synastry.
